system.specialAbility:
You become Trained in Athletics and Survival, and you become Trained in a relevant Lore of your choice.

Example Lores include Agriculture Lore, Animal Husbandry Lore, Lore of a farming region.
system.description: You worked the land or tended livestock, measuring the year by weather and harvests. You learned to make each season's labor last through the next, even when the seasons refused to cooperate.
